notes.title: Survey done! Thank you to all that participated!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34798748/61ac52cf7ac67458ed28cf67642e66bee3b2f3a7.png[/img]

Well, you heard it! We hit the required amount of entries and the survey is now officially done! Thanks to all that submitted answers and make sure to follow our developer page to get news of the next survey + giveaway:

https://store.steampowered.com/curator/34798748

For those of y'all that did answer, expect an email within the next 48 hours so you can get a free game. If you don't get an email one of these three things happened:

1. You didn't put in your email properly.

2. You answered too quickly, had inconsistent answers and the form looked like a robot.

3. You used a bot to answer the survey.

The vast majority of you should be fine and should receive an email very soon! 

Peace!

Ricky

notes.title: King Key Games Survey Part 2 CLOSED - Thank you to all that participated
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34798748/2b370b978ebba63f37577823a471256f2038e672.png[/img]

Yo Dawgs,

This time we had a truly amazing amount of people submit responses for the new survey. Thank you ever so much to all that participated! We decided at the end that everyone that gave valid responses will be receiving a free game key.

Since a lot of the questions had long form answers, it will take a lot of time to go through all of these so give Ol' Uncle Ricky a while to get back to y'all. If your survey passed the screening test and had valid answers you should receive an email in a couple of days asking you what game you want. If you haven't received an email, one of these conditions may have happened:

1. You didn't type in your email properly. In both surveys, you'd be shocked how many people didn't type their emails in properly and we got replies from mailer-daemons. 

2. You didn't answer in English.

3. You answered the long form questions with either a single word or with a nonsense answer. This happened quite a bit. Quite a few people seemed to have not read the rules and instructions on the form and just rushed through with single word responses.

Just so y'all know, the vast majority of people didn't do anything wrong, but if you don't get an email from me by Friday then you probably fell under one of the above three categories.

For the most part, the answers were real insightful and will help towards us making you better games, so thanks for that!

Peace!

Ricky
